project.name: GemPBA Dashboard :: UI
project.description: The SWT render-only views: the card hierarchy, the tile grid, dialogs, and the settings strip — all rendering the domain read-model and implementing the core view contracts. Depends on core and SWT ONLY. It does not (and, because it never depends on the adapters module, CANNOT) import the wire protocol: that dependency rule is enforced by this missing edge.
